info.title: Portal Research Retained Current-Source API
info.description: RS-02 named same-origin reads over Portal-retained, P05-sealed QuantBT 1.1.1 Advanced WFO data. These routes never run QuantBT, reopen source bytes, expose an artifact/table/lease input or raw fold/candidate payload, or replace P04 fixed-run contracts. Parameter maps are capped at 24 declared fields. Runtime Zod contracts are strict; this document is the generated-client source. RF-05 CG-P13-09 (additive): a run whose admitted profile can never be retained in this lane (the P04 fixed qualification) is answered 200 with `LaneNotApplicable` (schema_version research.current-source-not-applicable.v1) on every read, so a screen can skip the lane without an error; PENDING_SOURCE / PENDING_RETENTION / NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY / NOT_RETAINED_TERMINAL remain 409 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_CONFLICT refusals whose Problem `details.lane_state` names the state. W1 (additive): provenance names one of two lane pairs — rs02.quantbt-advanced-wfo.v1/rs02.delta-wfo-global.v1 or rs02.quantbt-signal-notional-wfo.v1/rs02.delta-signal-notional-wfo.v1 (the Delta signal-notional WFO execution profile); a WFO run without a seal is a PENDING_SOURCE/PENDING_RETENTION refusal, never LaneNotApplicable. W3 (additive, P13–P15 on real WFO data): Evidence adds `claim` (the S04 claim strip, verbatim QuantBT tokens, CG-P13-07) and `fold_verdicts` (per-fold S_OOS/decay/trades/max DD/return/worst bar with the versioned server rule research.fold-verdict.v1, CG-P13-08); EvidenceSeries observation kinds serve up to 2000 retained rows, then an extrema-preserving bucket sample, with a whole-relation `envelope` (CG-P13-05); Split folds add `anatomy` (warm-up/label-horizon/purge/embargo/validation windows) and the split adds run-level `guards` (CG-P14-02); Search trials/candidates add typed `state` and `facts` (stage, objective kind, fold scope, metrics, objective components), selection adds `roles` (raw IS best vs selected vs centroid), plus `search_contract`, `ledger.fold_filter` (`?fold=`) and `diagnostics.probe` (CG-P15-03/04). A seal retained before W3 answers every new fact as a typed absence. W5b (additive, P17 on the signal-notional route): each Replay Observation carries `bar` — the candle QuantBT consumed (the run's analysed HMD bar) and the final account's own fee/turnover/funding/rejected orders with a running checkpoint; `state_at_cursor.bar` is that checkpoint at the selected playhead; Replay adds `execution` (route contract, counted order/fill/trade records, totals, fold capital with per-fold segments and seek cursors, an OHLC overview of at most 160 extrema-keeping buckets, and the sequence policy) and route_capabilities for transitions/fees/funding/fold_capital/trades/partial_fills/oco/multi_leg/sl_tp/mae_mfe/execution_events. `GET .../current-source/replay/transitions` pages the close-target transition ledger (target transitions settled at the close with the account fee — never fills) over the original bar ordinal. A window with a hole in its dense sealed ordinals is refused 503 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GAP. A seal retained before W5b answers `bar: null` and `execution.state = NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY` (RS02_SEAL_PREDATES_W5B_REPLAY_BAR_LEDGER).

get.description: Cursor-bearing response is private/no-store. Use cursor/before for a relation page or at for a minted playhead; never reuse a stale cache body.
Cursor-bearing response is private/no-store. Rows are retained research-model samples, never broker execution state.
W5b: target transitions settled at the close with the account fee, keyset over the original bar ordinal. Private/no-store; never fills, never a trade pairing.

At.name: at
At.description: Opaque playhead minted by this exact run/revision/relation.

Fold.name: fold
Fold.description: W3: keep ledger rows whose published fold scope covers this retained fold id; cursors bind the filter.

Problem.description: Typed refusal with no source path, table selector, artifact locator, lease, raw market slice or credential.

Freeze.description: Local retained manifest/batch-receipt verification; no GET reopens source artifact bytes

Provenance.description: W1: exactly one admitted RS-02 lane pair; the source adapter and profile are never mixed.

LaneNotApplicable.description: RF-05 CG-P13-09: the run's immutable P10 adapter binding is the P04 fixed qualification, which can never be sealed into the RS-02 Advanced-WFO lane. Nothing is pending; do not retry.

retainable_profile_id.description: The P04 fixed qualification always emits rs02.delta-wfo-global.v1 (byte-stable).

LaneState.description: RF-05 CG-P13-09: `details.lane_state` of a 409 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_CONFLICT. PENDING_SOURCE: the run has not completed. PENDING_RETENTION: completed, sealed artifact not yet retained. NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY: a 1.0.8 metadata row, never retained. NOT_RETAINED_TERMINAL: cancelled/failed without a retained artifact.

code.description: A ProblemCode on these routes; the session guard may answer 401 with its own code.

ClaimStrip.description: S04 claim strip: engine tokens verbatim; an unpublished fact keeps value null with a typed reason.

FoldVerdicts.description: Per-fold verdicts under a versioned server rule; the frontend holds no threshold.

ProblemCode.description: CG-P17-02: every `error.code` a retained current-source read can return. 409 CONFLICT carries `details.lane_state`; SEQUENCE_GAP (503, W5b) is a retained relation read back with a hole — never retried into an invented row.

ReplayBar.description: W5b: one bar of the final account. `transition` is a change of the engine's accepted position; on close_target_v2 it is settled at the close and is never a fill.

ReplayExecution.description: W5b: what the signal-notional route really produced, retained at seal time.

equity_continuity.description: CONTINUOUS: one stitched account (fold k starts at fold k-1's end equity). RESET_PER_FOLD: each fold is its own account and must not be compounded.

anyOf.description: At most 160 OHLC buckets over the whole run: a bucket's high/low are the true extrema of its bars, so the run's price range survives the downsample.

source_ordinal.description: Original bar ordinal; sparse across transitions, never renumbered.
